tailoring.headline: SAP Inhouse Consultant – Commerce Cloud & CX Specialist with 5+ years SAP Commerce Cloud experience
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs and micro-services, plus hands-on integration of PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Proven techno-functional consulting: analysing business requirements, designing end-to-end e-commerce journeys, and steering international projects. Skilled in CI/CD, cloud deployments, incident, change and release management, and agile international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Inhouse Consultant Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Busch Vacuum Solutions’ ambition to shape the future of vacuum technology through innovative digital commerce. With 5+ years of end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in e-commerce architecture, integration and techno-functional consulting that aligns perfectly with your vision.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I analysed complex business requirements, authored user stories and functional specs, and translated them into SAP Commerce Cloud solutions that streamlined product and pricing processes.

bullets.label: Integration Expertise
bullets.text: I designed and optimised PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) and resolved integration bottlenecks with SAP ERP and MDM, ensuring consistent product data across global channels.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Development
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST services, customised back-office components and implemented headless commerce APIs that powered seamless storefront and third-party integrations.

bullets.label: Project & Release Management
bullets.text: I led API migration projects, coordinated with international technical teams, and managed incident, change and release cycles using CI/CD pipelines on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2).

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Inhouse Consultant Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Die Möglichkeit, bei Busch Vacuum Solutions die digitale Commerce-Strategie mitzugestalten, begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Implementierung von SAP Commerce Cloud bei Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich fundierte Kenntnisse in E-Commerce-Architekturen, Integration und techno-funktionaler Beratung, die exakt zu Ihren Anforderungen passen.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich Geschäftsanforderungen analysiert, User Stories und Funktionsspezifikationen erstellt und in SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen umgesetzt, die Produkt- und Preisprozesse optimierten.

bullets.label: Integrations-Expertise
bullets.text: Ich habe PIM-zu-Hybris Datenpipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) konzipiert und Integrationsengpässe zwischen SAP ERP und MDM behoben, um konsistente Produktdaten global sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: E-Commerce-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich entwickelte OCC-REST-Services, passte Backoffice-Komponenten an und implementierte Headless-Commerce-APIs für nahtlose Storefront- und Drittanbieter-Integrationen.

bullets.label: Projekt- und Release-Management
bullets.text: Ich leitete API-Migrationsprojekte, koordinierte internationale technische Teams und steuerte Incident-, Change- und Release-Prozesse mittels CI/CD-Pipelines auf dem SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2).

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Aufenthaltserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meine Ideen für Ihre digitale Zukunft einzubringen.

tailoring.why_company: Busch Vacuum Solutions combines cutting-edge vacuum technology with a strong commitment to sustainability – a blend that resonates with my passion for innovative, environmentally responsible digital solutions. Your global footprint and focus on continuous improvement provide the ideal environment for me to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to drive seamless e-commerce experiences across diverse industries.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Busch Vacuum Solutions accelerate its digital commerce, leveraging my SAP Commerce Cloud and integration experience to deliver robust, customer-centric solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud specialist with 5+ years in e-commerce integration. I’m eager to discuss how I can support Busch Vacuum Solutions’ digital transformation. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Inhouse Consultant Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Inhouse Consultant Commerce Cloud position at Busch Vacuum Solutions. I bring over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience and am available to start on 16 December 2026.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for the role.

Best regards
